items.reasoning: The AI-generated image has the correct general structure but significantly distorts the quantitative values. The conventional FL theory curve is placed much higher than in the ground truth (~0.1-0.8×10⁸ vs ~0.05-0.15×10⁸), and the quantum geometry curve is also much higher (~0.4-2.0×10⁸ vs ~0.2-0.5×10⁸). This reduces the visible enhancement factor to ~4-5× instead of the required ~10× order-of-magnitude enhancement. The report text also contains internal inconsistencies with the plotted values.

items.reasoning: The AI report captures the general concept of quadratic current dependence but has fundamental errors: (1) The DC critical current is reported as 0.8 mA vs the ground truth's 50 nA — a ~16,000× error in magnitude and completely wrong units (mA vs nA). (2) The key verification plot showing ΔD_s vs I² with linear fit (slope = 0.0401) is entirely missing from the AI output. (3) The microwave analysis is presented as current dependence rather than the ground truth's power dependence of resonance frequency. (4) The theoretical comparison plot (quadratic vs linear Meissner) is absent. (5) No explicit R² > 0.98 value is provided. While the qualitative conclusion about quadratic suppression is directionally correct, the quantitative results deviate severely from the paper, and critical verification elements are missing.
